content.description: An instructional infographic from the North Carolina Department of Revenue (NCDOR) outlines guidelines for completing and printing handwritten tax forms. The diagram uses icons and text to illustrate best practices, such as using blue or black ink, printing at "actual size" on one side of the paper, and submitting original documents rather than photocopies.

A blue instructional sign with a header reading "Guidelines" displays a checklist icon followed by instructions to use blue or black ink instead of red. Two paper icons illustrate this: one with blue and black lines has a green checkmark, while one with red lines has a red "X" mark.

A document guideline sign displays an icon of an open book with checkmarks and x-marks at the top, followed by the text, "Do not use red ink" and "Use blue or black ink." Below the text, there are two icons of documents: one with blue and black lines marked with a green checkmark, and one with red lines marked with a red X.

content.text: Do not use dollar signs, commas, or other punction marks

content.description: A graphic with a light blue, rounded background displays a reminder to omit special symbols when entering data. It lists "Do not use dollar signs, commas, or other punctuation marks" above a box containing a dollar sign, comma, question mark, bracket, and a red "X" icon.

An infographic section providing printing and mailing guidelines for official forms. It features a prominent "Printing" header with an icon, instructions to use black ink, and a visual warning against using red ink on documents.

An infographic section highlights printing guidelines, featuring a central "Printing" header with an icon of a printer and instructions to "select" specific settings. To the left, an icon warns against using red ink, while to the right, a diagram illustrates correct document formatting for an NCDOR form.

content.text: Do not print on both sides of the paper

content.description: A graphic with rounded blue panels provides printing instructions for a document. The central panel illustrates requirements to "select actual size" and "do not print on both sides of the paper," marked with icons showing the correct paper dimensions and a printer with a "no" symbol over double-sided printing.

A diagram instructing users not to mix different NCDOR tax form types before mailing. It shows two overlapping forms, with a red X symbol placed over them to indicate that combining "Web-Fill" and "Web" versions is incorrect.

An instructional graphic for mailing tax forms states "Before Mailing" and "Do not mix form types." It shows two NCDOR tax forms layered on top of each other, with a large red "X" over the top one to illustrate that different form versions, marked "Web-Fill" and "Web," should not be submitted together.

content.text: Do not submit photocopies of returns

content.description: A pale blue rounded rectangle contains the text "Do not submit photocopies of returns" and "Submit originals only," accompanied by an icon of a printer with a red "X" superimposed over it.
